data.long_meaning: From the Greek word "felos" meaning happy, rejoicing. The name Felecia carries the meaning “Happy, Rejoicing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with joy and happiness, reflecting the blessings of the Lord.

in_hebrew.name: פלקיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פלקיה (Felicita) - שמחה, תודעה, חגיגה. מקור: ראשי תיבות של 'פלא קדושה' - 'פ' (p - wonder, miracle), 'ל' (l - sacred), 'ק' (q - holy), 'י' (y - divine), 'ה' (h - sacred), 'א' (a - Godly). בשנים האחרונות, נפוצה בקרב יהודים ויהודיות, שם זה נדרש בגלל האגדה היהודית על 'פלקיה' - 'אשה שמחה'.

in_greek.name: Φελίτια
in_greek.long_meaning: Φελίτια (Felitia) - η χαρούμενη, η ευτυχισμένη. Πηγή: αρχαία ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος 'Φελίτια', που σημαίνει 'η χαρούμενη'. Στη Βυζαντινή περίοδο, το όνομα 'Φελίτια' ήταν ένα κοινό όνομα μεταξύ των χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Felicia
in_latin.long_meaning: Felicia - beata, felix, beatitudo. Origine: derivato dal termine latino 'felicitas', che significa 'felicità', 'fortuna'. Nel Medioevo, il nome 'Felicia' era associato alla virtù della felicità e della fortuna.

in_english.name: Felecia
in_english.long_meaning: Felecia is an English name derived from the Latin name Felicia, meaning 'happy', 'blessed', or 'fortunate'. The name Felicia has its roots in the Latin word 'felicitas', meaning 'happiness' or 'good fortune'. In Christian tradition, the name Felecia is associated with the virtue of happiness and good fortune. It is also associated with the Latin phrase 'beata felicitas', which means 'blessed happiness'.

data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Felecia encourages believers to remember the joy and celebration that comes with their faith in God. It serves as a reminder to always approach life with a joyful heart,, no matter the circumstances, consistently reflecting the love and grace of God.
